levi_civita_identities.determinant: det A = eps_ijk a_1i a_2j a_3k
levi_civita_identities.pseudotensor: changes sign under an improper rotation (det = -1)

cauchy_stress_tensor.traction: T_j = sigma_ij n_i  (the FIRST index of sigma is contracted with n)
cauchy_stress_tensor.transformation: sigma'_ij = a_im a_jn sigma_mn, i.e. sigma' = A sigma A^T with A the active rotation (A = C^T in the book's passive convention)
cauchy_stress_tensor.I2: 1/2 [ (tr sigma)^2 - tr(sigma^2) ] = sigma_1 sigma_2 + sigma_2 sigma_3 + sigma_3 sigma_1

rotation_matrix.meaning: active: rotates points counterclockwise by theta; a rotation of the axes (passive/alias) uses R^T
rotation_matrix.rodrigues: R = cos(theta) I + sin(theta) [u]_x + (1 - cos(theta)) u u^T

stokes_theorem.statement: oint_{dSigma} F . dr = iint_Sigma (curl F) . n dS
stokes_theorem.orientation: the positive direction around the boundary and the positive normal are related by the right-hand rule
stokes_theorem.our_V1_case: u = b x x, disc of radius R perpendicular to b: circulation = 2 |b| pi R^2
